verdict.rationale: uv documents several built-in bulk operations. `uv add -r` adds every dependency from a requirements file in one go, `uv cache clean` clears the entire cache, and `--refresh` revalidates cached data for all dependencies on any command. A community user, however, reports there is no elegant way to bump all dependencies at once and wrote a custom script for it, so bulk coverage is uneven. missing for 10: a documented bulk upgrade of all dependencies or tools, a general batch mechanism across many projects or items, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: you can use `uv add` with the `-r` flag to add all dependencies from the file
To clear the cache entirely, run `uv cache clean`.
To force uv to revalidate cached data for all dependencies, pass `--refresh` to any command
